Plot fold change scatterplot, drug vs. T0, control vs. T0

Source: R/report.R
plot_fc_scatterplot.Rd

This function generates a scatterplot comparing fold changes between drug treatment and control conditions

Usage

plot_fc_scatterplot(
  sgRNA_fc_df = NULL,
  x_column = "T4_control_vs_T0_FC",
  y_column = "T4_drug_vs_T0_FC",
  x_lab = "Control vs T0",
  y_lab = "Drug vs T0",
  title = "T4 - sgRNA abundance LFC",
  title_y_right_margin = 12,
  title_x_top_margin = 12,
  ggsci_style = "JCO",
  treatment_name = "FGF401",
  per_sgRNA = TRUE,
  highlight_genes = TRUE,
  plot_fontsize = 13
)

Arguments

sgRNA_fc_df

A data frame containing sgRNA fold change data

x_column

The name of the column to use for the x-axis (default is "T4_control_vs_T0_FC")

y_column

The name of the column to use for the y-axis (default is "T4_drug_vs_T0_FC")

x_lab

The label for the x-axis (default is "T4 - Control vs T0 - fold change (normalized sgRNA count)")

y_lab

The label for the y-axis (default is "T4 - Drug vs T0 - fold change (normalized sgRNA count)")

title

The title of the scatterplot (default is "T4 - sgRNA fold change")

title_y_right_margin

Right margin for the y-axis title (default is 12)

title_x_top_margin

Top margin for the x-axis title (default is 12)

ggsci_style

The style for the color palette from the ggsci package (default is "JCO")

treatment_name

The name of the treatment used in the experiment (default is " FGF401")

per_sgRNA

Logical indicating whether to plot at the sgRNA level (TRUE) or gene level (FALSE) (default is TRUE)

highlight_genes

Logical indicating whether to highlight specific genes on the scatterplot (default is TRUE)

plot_fontsize

Font size for the plot text elements (default is 11

Value

A ggplot2 object representing the fold change scatterplot
